title: Dos & Don'ts / Typography
slide_intent: Limit typographic variation so headline hierarchy remains clear rather than competing with itself.
strategic_value: Restrained case, weight mixing and color can keep DB headlines coherent.
demonstration: Three paired examples contrast short capitals with long uppercase text, two weights with excessive mixing, and standard colors with colored type.
practical_value: Check headline length, number of weights and color before approving a composition.

content_islands.name: Case comparison
content_islands.spec: Pair short uppercase lettering with the crossed-out long uppercase example.

content_islands.name: Weight comparison
content_islands.spec: Contrast limited weight pairing with excessive variation.

content_islands.name: Color comparison
content_islands.spec: Pair Black and White with a crossed-out colored-text example.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says too many weights undermine hierarchy and make a composition unsettled.
reference_purposes.Constraint: At most two weights may be combined in one headline; long or multiline headlines are not entirely uppercase; standard type is Black or White with Cold Black only for expressive headlines.
reference_purposes.Application: Positive and negative specimens make the three checks visible.
